summary: IoT Based Smart Waste Management System — a production-ready SaaS-style smart city monitoring web app built with React.js + Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, and Recharts. Features landing page, mock admin login, sidebar dashboard, multi-bin monitoring with real-time simulated data, smart alert system, analytics charts, mock map view, and security section. Blue + green smart city theme with glassmorphism design, dark/light mode, and fully responsive layout.
architectural_notes: Stack: React.js + Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, Recharts
Design: Glassmorphism cards, blue + green smart city theme, smooth animations, professional typography
Bin data is simulated client-side with auto-updating intervals (no real IoT backend)
Authentication is mock only — no real backend auth

existing_features.title: Create a public Landing Page with: (1) an animated gradient hero section with title 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System' and tagline 'Smart IoT Solution for Real-Time Waste Monitoring'; (2) a Problem Statement section displaying waste overflow statistics; (3) a Solution Overview section with a visual architecture flow diagram showing Sensor → NodeMCU → Cloud → Dashboard; (4) an 'Access Dashboard' button that navigates to the Admin Login page.

Create an Admin Login Page with mock authentication: email and password input fields, a show/hide password toggle, client-side validation (non-empty email format, non-empty password), and on successful validation redirect the user to the main Dashboard.

Implement a persistent sidebar dashboard layout wrapping all authenticated pages. Sidebar must include navigation items: Dashboard, Bin Monitoring, Analytics, Alerts, Map View, Reports, Settings, and Logout. Logout clears auth state and redirects to the Login page. Sidebar should collapse on mobile with a hamburger toggle.

Build a Dashboard Overview page showing animated counter cards for: Total Smart Bins (5), Active Alerts (count from alert state), Waste Collected Today (simulated kg value), System Status (Online/Offline), and Network Health (percentage). Counters should animate from 0 to their target value on page load.

Create a Bin Monitoring page simulating 5 smart bins. Each bin card must show: a circular progress indicator displaying waste fill percentage, color-coded status (green 0–50%, yellow 50–80%, red 80–100%), location name, and last updated timestamp. Bin fill values must auto-update via a simulated interval (every 3–5 seconds) with small random increments/decrements.

Implement a Smart Alert System: when any bin's fill level exceeds 80%, automatically show a toast/popup notification and add an entry to an alert log table (columns: Bin ID, Location, Fill Level, Time, Status, Action). Each alert row must include a 'Dispatch Collection' button that, when clicked, resets the bin level to ~10%, marks the alert as resolved in the table, and logs the collection event.

Build an Analytics page using Recharts with three dynamically updating charts: (1) a Line Chart showing waste levels over time for all bins; (2) a Bar Chart comparing current fill levels across the 5 bins; (3) a Pie Chart showing waste distribution by bin location. Charts must reflect the live simulated bin data and refresh as values change.

Create a Map View page with a mock Google Maps-style interface (CSS grid/SVG-based city map background). Place 5 color-coded markers (green/yellow/red matching bin fill thresholds) at distinct positions representing bin locations. Clicking a marker opens a detail popup showing the bin's name, fill level, status, and last updated time.

Add a Security section (accessible from the sidebar under Settings or as a dedicated page) displaying four informational cards: Data Encryption (AES-256 concept), Secure API Communication (HTTPS/TLS), Role-Based Access Control, and Cloud Data Protection. Each card should include an icon, a title, and a brief description.

Add a Reports page (accessible from the sidebar) displaying a summary table of recent collection events logged by the Dispatch Collection action, showing columns: Date/Time, Bin ID, Location, Fill Level at Dispatch, and Status. Include a mock 'Export CSV' button.

Implement a global Dark/Light mode toggle accessible from the sidebar or top navigation bar. The entire application (all pages, cards, charts, and sidebar) must respond to the theme change with appropriate color schemes.

Apply a cohesive Blue + Green smart city design system across the entire application: glassmorphism-style cards (frosted glass effect with subtle borders), smooth CSS transitions and animations, professional typography (clean sans-serif), and fully responsive layout supporting mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.

Update the browser tab title in frontend/index.html to 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System'. Also ensure any visible page-level headings or app name labels across the application (sidebar header, landing page hero title, login page header) consistently display 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System'.
